meta.title: agenticengineering.nl
meta.description: Agentic engineering trainings with Claude Code or Codex.

hero.title: Train your team in agentic engineering.
hero.subtitle: Two hands-on trainings in Claude Code or Codex. Two days foundations, one day advanced.

basic.name: Basic
basic.tagline: Two days of hands-on adoption — every attendee ships a feature.
audience: Whole DevOps teams: developers, QA / test engineers, ops / platform
Mixed-role cohorts adopting agentic workflows together
Engineering managers training their teams alongside them
prerequisites: Comfortable with git and the command line
Writes features in at least one language (TS/Python/Go/etc.)
outcomes: Ship a working feature end-to-end on a starter repo
Configure structured context (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md, rules) for your own project
Use existing MCP servers in real workflows
Practise a test-first loop with an agent
Set up hooks and quality gates that survive the next sprint

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.tagline: One day to scale agentic engineering across your teams.
audience: Tech leads and staff+ engineers rolling out agentic workflows
Engineering managers and platform / QA leads
Teams responsible for governance, cost, and adoption across orgs
prerequisites: Basic training or equivalent hands-on Claude Code/Codex experience
outcomes: Leave with a rollout playbook for your own org
Orchestrate subagents and parallel agents at team scale
Enforce team policy via CI hooks
Set up observability and cost guardrails for agent usage
Walk away with a 90-day rollout plan reviewed by peers

fundamentals-of-agent.title: Fundamentals of an agent
bullets: What an agent is and why it works
Difference vs chat and vs automation

using-mcp-servers.title: Using MCP servers
bullets: Connect existing servers (Filesystem, GitHub, Linear, etc.)

test-first-intro.title: Test-first strategy (intro)
bullets: When to test first, when to test later

agent-harnessing.title: Agent harnessing for teams
bullets: Subagents and delegation at team scale
Parallel workflows that survive team-sized PR queues

capstone-ship-feature.title: Capstone — ship a feature end-to-end
bullets: Implement a small feature on a starter repo from a brief
Drive the work with tests, hooks, and quality gates
Demo and review with the cohort

governance-and-policy-gates.title: Governance + policy gates
bullets: Decide what policy your team needs (security, cost, quality)
Enforce policy via CI hooks rather than tribal review

capstone-rollout-tabletop.title: Capstone — rollout tabletop
bullets: Design a 90-day rollout plan for your own org
Peer review and stress-test of the plan
Concrete next steps to take home
